About the Portal

The Skin Knowledge Portal enables browsing, searching, and analysis of human genetic information linked to skin diseases and related traits, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.

field_about_project:
About the project

The Skin Knowledge Portal is being developed by the Skin Genetics Consortium (SGC), an international network of scientists and clinicians collaborating to advance our understanding of the genetic underpinnings of skin diseases by leveraging large-scale genomic data, with a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard. 

We welcome contributions of data and the involvement of interested researchers in collaborations on analyses, methods, or tool development. Please contact us for more information.
field_tagline: Advancing our understanding of skin disease through large-scale genomic data
